slides.title: Reports move to the cloud behind stable data contracts, so the new ERP rollout does not break them
bullets: Today's data setup and the new ERP feed one integration layer with a contract per business object. Dashboards read a modelled reporting layer in the public cloud, not the ERP directly.
Discovery ranks legacy apps by ROI; we replace only those where the saving exceeds the cost, top one first, in parallel until proven.
